boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 118 layers a red threshold bar across a 6×6 Lego-textured grid with side-rail counters and a star-patterned cyan pocket that must survive the mid-run intact. The grid slides in rows — each push ripples across all six columns. The center red block looks harmless, but sliding it before the right rail drops buries the star pocket under shifting debris.
landmarks: Block Out Level 118 layers a red threshold bar across a 6×6 Lego-textured grid with side-rail counters and a star-patterned cyan pocket that must survive the mid-run intact.
The grid slides in rows — each push ripples across all six columns.
The center red block looks harmless, but sliding it before the right rail drops buries the star pocket under shifting debris.

quickTips: Do not split the star-patterned cyan 3×3 pocket — it anchors the left-center slides.
Save the right yellow L-cluster until the bottom purple `2` counter appears.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Break the upper cyan tetromino under the red threshold bar without crossing the left `2` rail.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Peel the left green column while keeping the star-patterned cyan 3×3 pocket intact.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Shift the bottom red downward-arrow block through the center after the left rail drops to `10`.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Feed the right-rail `6` and `8` counts down with the green right-arrow lane.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the yellow L-cluster on the right only after the bottom purple `2` counter is visible.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Exit the last red and yellow scraps through the open downward lane for the board clear.

failurePoints: Splitting the star-patterned cyan pocket too early, which removes the left-center anchor.
Moving the right yellow L-cluster before the bottom purple `2` counter is visible.
